meta_title: Margarita Makri | Psychologist - Psychotherapist in Larissa
meta_description: Margarita Makri, Psychologist - Psychotherapist in Larissa, Greece. Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT) for adults, couples and adolescents, in person and online.
hero_text: Cognitive Behavioural Therapy for adults, couples and adolescents. Sessions in Larissa and online.
welcome_text:
Asking for help is not always easy. Often the hardest step is the first phone call.

In our sessions you will find a calm, confidential space where we can look together at what is troubling you and work on it in practical ways, at your own pace.
credentials: BSc in Psychology, Aristotle University of Thessaloniki
MSc in Clinical Mental Health, AUTh Medical School

quotes.text: The universe is change; our life is what our thoughts make it.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: People are disturbed not by things, but by the views they take of them.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.text: Who looks outside, dreams; who looks inside, awakes.
quotes.author: Carl Jung

services_text: Choose the topic that concerns you to see how we work.
approach_text: I work with Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT), a structured method with strong research support. Together we look at how thoughts, feelings and behaviour influence one another, and try practical ways to change.
contact_sessions: By appointment, in person and online
